إِيَالٌ The vessel, or receptacle, of thickening, or thick, milk: (M:) [or, accord. to the K, this seems to be termed ↓ أُيَّلٌ : see آئِلٌ:] or, in which wine (شَرَاب), or expressed juice, or what is pressed, or squeezed, so that its juice is forced out, or the like thereof, is made to thicken. (TA.) ＝
-A2- [Also an inf. n. of 1, which see throughout.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
